three_axes.local_capacity: 670M trainable parameters does not prove sufficient useful capacity, but merely enlarging the reader is not supported. The observed deficiency is that the learned physical message can disrupt local identity and structure. Explicit state interaction from R10A is retained in the next candidate rather than replacing it with a C-only additive write.
three_axes.condition_use: A has diverse C but the correct/wrong control does not show net benefit. Existing physical slots describe reasoning sentences, whereas the native generation task is the original request; the two attentions can select different semantic content.
three_axes.fusion_execution_match: Current direct physical addressing is independent of the current layer native request attention. This is a code fact. That independence is a plausible source of mismatch, not uniquely established by the controls. The next candidate makes physical values available through native request keys and tests the binding directly.

historical_basis.R1: Cross-benchmark reference remains WMB600/700 and PIQ.2651032257782627. Its balanced results are the acceptance reference, not PC alone.
historical_basis.R9: Native-query grounded conditioning is a useful reference; no claim of having solved all targets.
historical_basis.R10A: Own40 PC3.75, butSA2.825/J7; fixed16 full3.0625/3.875/J4 versus noC3.25/3.625/J6. Preserve its physical execution capacity while addressing semantic mismatch.
historical_basis.R11B: Independent request writing harmedSA/Joint and some videos; do not reproduce that independent output path.
historical_basis.R12B_R13A_R13B_R13C: Text multiplication, native FFN modulation and native videoQ/K modulation did not achieve combined targets. Do not repeat them merely with different weights.

inference_limits: Paired inference interventions establish dependence of a trained checkpoint, not retrained component causality. Selected frames do not replace exhaustive video judgment. No conclusion from FM scalar alone.
